notebooks.name: ingest_sales_raw
notebooks.description: Ingests raw sales data from CSV files into the bronze layer. Reads pre-loaded bronze_customers and bronze_products as reference data. Writes bronze_sales with ingestion metadata columns (_ingestion_timestamp, _source_system, _batch_id).

notebooks.name: transform_sales
notebooks.description: Cleans and enriches raw sales data. Parses sale_timestamp into sale_date and sale_hour, calculates total_amount, determines is_weekend flag, assigns amount_bucket classification, and computes a data quality score. Writes silver_sales.

notebooks.name: transform_products
notebooks.description: Enriches product data with calculated business metrics. Computes profit_margin as (unit_price - cost) / unit_price and assigns price_tier classification (Budget, Mid-Range, Premium, Luxury) based on unit_price thresholds. Filters to active products only (94 of 100).

notebooks.name: ft_sales
notebooks.description: Aggregates silver sales into a business-ready fact table. Groups by sale_date, product_id, customer_id, channel, and region. Calculates total_quantity, total_revenue, transaction_count, price statistics, and revenue-per-transaction metrics. Adds fiscal calendar fields (year, quarter, month) and a surrogate fact_key.

notebooks.name: dm_product
notebooks.description: Creates the product dimension for business reporting. Reads silver_products and adds margin_band classification (Low <20%, Medium 20-40%, High 40-60%, Premium >60%) and a surrogate product_key. Serves as the primary product dimension for Power BI.

notebooks.name: create_demo_tables
notebooks.description: Setup utility that creates initial demo tables with synthetic data for Acme Manufacturing. Generates bronze_customers (500 rows) and bronze_products (100 rows) with realistic fake data. Run once to bootstrap the demo environment.

notebooks.name: list_tables
notebooks.description: Utility notebook that lists all tables in the workspace.default schema with their row counts and column details. Used for quick environment inspection and verification.

notebooks.name: query_tables
notebooks.description: Utility notebook that queries and displays sample data from all tables in the workspace. Shows first N rows from each table for quick data inspection and validation.

notebooks.name: verify_silver_products
notebooks.description: Quality verification notebook for silver_products. Checks row counts, validates profit_margin calculations, verifies price_tier assignments, and reports data quality statistics. Used after running transform_products to confirm correctness.
